display: Found 4 references to memopayload in 2 files

content:
The `memopayload` package is only referenced via its stateless `RebuildMemoPayload` function (called inline on memo create/update in `memo_service.go`). Its `Runner` type, `NewRunner`, and batch `RunOnce` scheduler are never instantiated or started by the server. Confirmed by the server.go read — only `s3presign` is wired into `startBackgroundRunners`.

q28.
s3presign runner — started once eagerly at startup (`RunOnce`), then runs continuously on a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`) in a goroutine until its context is cancelled at shutdown. `server/server.go:153-174`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-45`.

Unused-infra note: The `memopayload` runner (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) provides a batch scheduler (`Runner` type + `NewRunner` + `RunOnce` that rebuilds every memo's payload) but the server never starts it — `startBackgroundRunners` only wires up `s3presign`. The only part of that package the server actually uses is the stateless helper `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`, called inline on memo create/update in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`. So the `memopayload` batch-runner scheduling infrastructure is present but unused by the server (it has no ticker/trigger and no caller of its `Runner`/`RunOnce`).
